data.headline: Nashville General Hospital Implements Oracle Health CommunityWorks to Simplify Clinician Experience, Enhance Patient Care
data.summary: Nashville General Hospital (NGH), Middle Tennessee's public safety-net hospital serving Davidson County and Nashville, Tennessee, is using Oracle Health CommunityWorks to better support its clinical, financial, and operational needs. Unifying its clinical operations with the new centralized and integrated electronic health records (EHR) across the 150-bed hospital and more than 20 outpatient and clinic settings enables NGH to automate several manual processes and replace disparate legacy systems

data.headline: Craig-Hallum upgrades Rimini Street to Buy following court ruling
data.summary: As previously reported, Craig-Hallum upgraded Rimini Street (RMNI) to Buy from Hold with a price target of $6, up from $2. The firm says that in “a stunningly decisive manner,” the Appeals Court panel vacated the district court’s prior opinion which ruled broadly against Rimini and in favor of Oracle (ORCL), around “infringing derivative works.” Craig-Hallum believes this outcome is the most positive it has ever seen for Rimini and while it does not believe the legal arguing is over by any means
